Usage: astryx build [options] [query]

Build a page: the template to start from, or the workflow playbook (no query)

Options:
  --type <domain>  Filter the kit to one domain (component|hook|doc|template|theme); doc and theme give an empty kit
  --limit <n>      Max candidates to draw from (default 60)
  --verbose        Verbose output (every block and component, full descriptions, import paths and match reason)
  -h, --help       display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success (including zero matches)
  1  invalid --type, a --limit that is not a positive integer, or a query when @astryxdesign/core cannot be found (the playbook needs no core)

Examples:
  # Get the playbook
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 build
  # Find the template to start from
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 build "analytics dashboard" --json

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/build
